description: React component for the appointment booking page in a doctor appointment application. It fetches doctor info, available slots, and allows users to book an appointment, displaying related doctors.

methods.name: fetchDocInfo
methods.description: Fetches doctor information based on docId from context data.

methods.name: getAvailableSolts
methods.description: Generates available appointment slots for the upcoming week based on doctor info.

methods.name: bookAppointment
methods.description: Handles booking an appointment by sending data to backend API.
